description: Weekly update PRs for flake inputs and GitHub Actions. CI evaluates each PR; merging it lets comin deploy.

lockFileMaintenance.description: The nix manager only refreshes flake.lock through lock file maintenance, and it is off by default. Without this, no flake input ever updates.

packageRules.description: All flake.lock updates (nixpkgs, home-manager, sops-nix, comin) in one PR

Leave rev-pinned flake inputs alone. An input pinned to a commit instead of a branch (currently just comin) is pinned on purpose, because the thing that performs deploys must not move unattended; flake.nix says to bump it by hand, to a release tag. A digest update is the only update type that rewrites such a pin, so turning it off is exactly that rule. Branch-tracking inputs (nixpkgs, home-manager, sops-nix) are unaffected: they move through lockFileMaintenance above, not digest updates.
